lead: A `.nvs` file anywhere under `tests/conformance/` fails every case in the tree.
body: `nvs test` refuses a directory holding both `.nvs` programs and `.nvst` cases, and the conformance step runs the whole tree in one invocation, so one stray program reports all 2598 cases failed. Data a test packs or copies keeps another extension there: the fixture extensions' Novis sources are `*.nvs.src` (`crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs`).
